offending_extra_words: Customer's payment obligations are not damages and are not limited by this Section.
reasons: The 21.1 cap edit is well targeted and complete: it replaces the illusory first-Order-Form/Implementation-Fee basis with the exact preferred greater-of construction (12-month claim-anchored fee limb plus USD 1,000,000 floor) while leaving mutuality, the damages exclusion and the Excluded Claims list untouched.

All preferred uncapped carve-outs (confidentiality, data protection, security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, other party's IP) were already present and were not disturbed.

Operation 2 was unnecessary for the target level: the original 21.3 sentence already carved Customer's payment obligation out of "damages", and the rewrite deletes the customer-favourable qualifiers "undisputed" and "for conforming Services", broadening our own unlimited exposure. This change should be dropped as non-minimal and adverse to us.

Minor drafting note: limb (a) uses lowercase "fees" to escape the narrow defined term "Fees" (USD 12,000 Implementation Fee); consider clarifying it means fees paid or payable under all Order Forms so the basis is not read back into clause 1.5.
